title: Recover a lost Gradle tool session by workflow ID

rubric.text: Gives gradle_run.py status --workflow aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa as the standalone read-only command. An inspection request does not authorize recover or a new run.
Explains run identity and the stored bounded result with result_sequence; while running, an available result can belong to the previous run. Does not suggest reading raw logs.

Waits or polls on running, checks exit_status for completed including failures, uses recorded signal evidence for interrupted, reports abandoned as unknown, and investigates ownership on uncertain without inferring completion or descendant absence from the recorded PIDs.
